fluidair.gui.title: Fluid Air Configuration
fluidair.config.comment.ignoreFluidPhysi: Treat fluids as air for all local-player movement, including sprinting, jumping, fall distance, Elytra flight, Riptide eligibility, currents, drag, and bubble columns. Non-movement fluid effects remain unchanged. This changes client-side movement prediction only.
fluidair.config.comment.openConfigGui: Opens the Fluid Air configuration screen.
